protocol_metadata.about: Tori Finance is a synthetic dollar protocol on Ethereum that lets users swap USDC or USDT for trUSD, a synthetic dollar backed by delta-neutral trading positions rather than fiat reserves. Users can stake trUSD to receive strUSD, an ERC-4626 vault share whose exchange rate rises as the protocol earns yield from institutional strategies including money-market carry trades, futures arbitrage, and calendar spreads. The protocol uses Accountable's zero-knowledge proof attestation layer for real-time proof of reserves and applies a 24-hour timelock on contract upgrades. Unstaking runs a seven-day cooldown; there are no deposit fees or minimums.
